<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#f7f7f2" />
  <title>Tidepool — Make room for a good week</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --ink: #183b3a;
      --ink-soft: #486260;
      --muted: #71817c;
      --paper: #f7f7f2;
      --white: #fffefa;
      --line: #e4e9e1;
      --teal: #136b62;
      --teal-dark: #0f554e;
      --mint: #d9eee4;
      --coral: #f28f73;
      --yellow: #f5d786;
      --lavender: #e7e3f4;
      --shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(26, 61, 56, .12);
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--ink);
      background: var(--paper);
      font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

    button, a { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }

    .shell {
      width: min(1160px, calc(100% - 48px));
      margin-inline: auto;
    }

    .nav {
      height: 82px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(24, 59, 58, .08);
    }

    .brand {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-weight: 760;
      font-size: 21px;
      letter-spacing: -1px;
    }

    .brand-mark {
      width: 31px;
      height: 31px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      border-radius: 11px;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: white;
    }

    .brand-mark svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 34px;
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 550;
    }

    .nav-links a:hover, .text-link:hover { color: var(--teal); }

    .nav-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 22px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .nav-login { color: var(--ink-soft); }

    .button {
      min-height: 48px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 9px;
      padding: 0 20px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 9px;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: #fff;
      font: inherit;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background .2s ease, transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
    }

    .button:hover {
      background: var(--teal-dark);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 9px 22px rgba(19, 107, 98, .2);
    }

    .button svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    .button-light {
      color: var(--teal);
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid #dce6df;
    }

    .button-light:hover { color: white; }

    .hero {
      min-height: 690px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: .91fr 1.09fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 45px;
      padding: 72px 0 86px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-copy { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    .eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      color: var(--teal);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 1.25px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .eyebrow-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--coral);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(242, 143, 115, .17);
    }

    h1, h2, h3, p { margin-top: 0; }

    h1 {
      max-width: 540px;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
      font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      font-size: clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px);
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: -3.5px;
      line-height: .99;
    }

    h1 em {
      color: var(--teal);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .hero-text {
      max-width: 450px;
      margin-bottom: 29px;
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      font-size: 17px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .hero-ctas {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 19px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .text-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .text-link svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; }

    .social-proof {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 37px;
    }

    .avatars { display: flex; padding-left: 4px; }

    .avatar {
      width: 31px;
      height: 31px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      margin-left: -5px;
      border: 2px solid var(--paper);
      border-radius: 50%;
      color: #294c48;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .avatar:nth-child(1) { background: #f4b6a0; }
    .avatar:nth-child(2) { background: #e5ce88; }
    .avatar:nth-child(3) { background: #b7d8c6; }
    .avatar:nth-child(4) { background: #c8c0e1; }

    .proof-copy {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .proof-copy strong { color: var(--ink); }

    .hero-art {
      position: relative;
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 23px 0 20px 16px;
    }

    .blob {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: -1;
      width: 470px;
      height: 470px;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      border-radius: 48% 52% 57% 43% / 47% 43% 57% 53%;
      background: #e5f0e7;
      transform: translate(-48%, -50%) rotate(-10deg);
    }

    .sparkle {
      position: absolute;
      top: 6px;
      right: 25px;
      color: var(--coral);
      font-size: 37px;
      transform: rotate(12deg);
    }

    .board {
      position: relative;
      width: min(100%, 570px);
      margin-left: auto;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid rgba(24, 59, 58, .1);
      border-radius: 15px;
      background: var(--white);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      transform: rotate(1.2deg);
    }

    .board-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 17px 20px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }

    .board-title {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 760;
      letter-spacing: -.2px;
    }

    .board-title-mark {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: #e3f1e9;
      color: var(--teal);
    }

    .board-title-mark svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; }

    .week-label {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .week-label .chevrons { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 16px; }

    .board-intro {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 18px 20px 15px;
    }

    .board-intro h2 {
      margin: 0 0 4px;
      font-size: 17px;
      letter-spacing: -.5px;
    }

    .board-intro p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .mini-people { display: flex; align-items: center; }

    .mini-person {
      width: 26px;
      height: 26px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      margin-left: -5px;
      border: 2px solid white;
      border-radius: 50%;
      color: #385550;
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .mini-person:nth-child(1) { background: #eec3ad; }
    .mini-person:nth-child(2) { background: #cbdcc0; }
    .mini-person:nth-child(3) { background: #d7c9e9; }
    .mini-person:nth-child(4) { background: #f2d889; }

    .board-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    }

    .day {
      min-height: 272px;
      padding: 12px 9px 15px;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
    }

    .day:last-child { border-right: 0; }

    .day-name {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 750;
      letter-spacing: .5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .day-name b {
      width: 22px;
      height: 22px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      border-radius: 50%;
      color: var(--ink);
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: 0;
    }

    .day.today .day-name b { color: white; background: var(--teal); }

    .task {
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      padding: 9px 8px 8px;
      border-radius: 7px;
      color: #35514c;
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .task small {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 6px;
      color: inherit;
      opacity: .72;
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 550;
    }

    .task.mint { background: #e2f0e6; }
    .task.peach { background: #fae5dc; }
    .task.lilac { background: #ece9f5; }
    .task.yellow { background: #f8f0d9; }
    .task.blue { background: #e3eef0; }

    .task.done {
      color: #7b9189;
      text-decoration: line-through;
      background: #f0f3ef;
    }

    .board-bottom {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 12px 18px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
      background: #fbfcf8;
    }

    .focus-note {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .focus-note span {
      width: 22px;
      height: 22px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      border-radius: 7px;
      background: var(--yellow);
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .board-progress {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 9px;
    }

    .progress-track {
      width: 67px;
      height: 5px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 5px;
      background: #e5ebe4;
    }

    .progress-track i {
      display: block;
      width: 62%;
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background: var(--teal);
    }

    .floating-note {
      position: absolute;
      right: -11px;
      bottom: 50px;
      width: 177px;
      padding: 13px 14px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(24, 59, 58, .08);
      border-radius: 11px;
      background: white;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(26, 61, 56, .13);
      transform: rotate(-3deg);
    }

    .floating-note-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      color: var(--teal);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .7px;
    }

    .floating-note p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .floating-note strong { color: var(--ink); }

    .trusted {
      padding: 28px 0 52px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .trusted-label {
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      color: #8a9991;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 1.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .logo-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: clamp(28px, 6vw, 74px);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      color: #72827b;
    }

    .wordmark {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 750;
      letter-spacing: -.7px;
      opacity: .8;
    }

    .wordmark.serif { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; }
    .wordmark.spaced { letter-spacing: 1.7px; font-size: 13px; }
    .wordmark svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

    .section {
      padding: 105px 0;
    }

    .section-heading {
      max-width: 610px;
      margin: 0 auto 52px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .section-kicker {
      margin-bottom: 13px;
      color: var(--teal);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 1.3px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    h2.section-title {
      margin-bottom: 15px;
      font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      font-size: clamp(36px, 4.2vw, 49px);
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: -1.8px;
      line-height: 1.08;
    }

    .section-subtitle {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .features {
      background: #edf3ec;
    }

    .feature-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 17px;
    }

    .feature-card {
      min-height: 260px;
      padding: 26px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(24, 59, 58, .08);
      border-radius: 13px;
      background: rgba(255, 254, 250, .8);
    }

    .feature-icon {
      width: 43px;
      height: 43px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      color: var(--teal);
      background: var(--mint);
    }

    .feature-card:nth-child(2) .feature-icon { color: #ad624e; background: #fae5dc; }
    .feature-card:nth-child(3) .feature-icon { color: #665f99; background: var(--lavender); }

    .feature-icon svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; }

    .feature-card h3 {
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      font-size: 17px;
      letter-spacing: -.4px;
    }

    .feature-card p {
      max-width: 290px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .how-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 90px;
    }

    .how-copy .section-kicker { margin-bottom: 15px; }

    .how-copy h2 {
      max-width: 480px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      font-size: clamp(38px, 4vw, 50px);
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: -1.8px;
      line-height: 1.08;
    }

    .how-copy > p {
      max-width: 460px;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.75;
    }

    .steps {
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .step {
      display: flex;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: flex-start;
    }

    .step-number {
      width: 26px;
      height: 26px;
      flex: 0 0 26px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      border-radius: 50%;
      color: var(--teal);
      background: #e4f0e6;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .step p {
      margin: 3px 0 0;
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .step strong { color: var(--ink); }

    .week-card {
      position: relative;
      padding: 24px;
      border: 1px solid #e5e9e2;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fbfcf8;
      box-shadow: 0 17px 50px rgba(26, 61, 56, .08);
    }

    .week-card::before {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: -1;
      content: "";
      width: 180px;
      height: 180px;
      top: -28px;
      right: -25px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #f7e8cb;
    }

    .week-card-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 23px;
    }

    .week-card-header h3 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 16px;
      letter-spacing: -.4px;
    }

    .week-card-header span {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .week-focus {
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: #e7f1e8;
    }

    .week-focus small {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      color: var(--teal);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .week-focus strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 11px;
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .focus-tags { display: flex; gap: 6px; }

    .focus-tags span {
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border-radius: 5px;
      color: #4e6960;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.7);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .week-agenda {
      display: grid;
      gap: 0;
      margin-top: 11px;
    }

    .agenda-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 45px 1fr auto;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 12px 3px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e9ece6;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .agenda-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
    .agenda-day { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 750; }
    .agenda-title { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }
    .agenda-owner { color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; }

    .quote-section {
      padding: 78px 0;
      background: #183b3a;
      color: white;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .quote-mark {
      margin-bottom: 17px;
      color: #9dd2b7;
      font-family: Georgia, serif;
      font-size: 58px;
      line-height: .6;
    }

    blockquote {
      max-width: 770px;
      margin: 0 auto 24px;
      font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      font-size: clamp(25px, 3.2vw, 37px);
      letter-spacing: -.7px;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .quote-attribution {
      color: #bfd0c9;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .quote-attribution strong { color: white; }

    .cta-section { padding: 95px 0; }

    .cta-card {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      padding: 68px 30px;
      border-radius: 17px;
      background: #e5f0e6;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .cta-card::before, .cta-card::after {
      position: absolute;
      content: "";
      width: 200px;
      height: 200px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(19, 107, 98, .12);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .cta-card::before { top: -112px; left: -50px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 22px rgba(19,107,98,.035), 0 0 0 44px rgba(19,107,98,.025); }
    .cta-card::after { right: -85px; bottom: -125px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 22px rgba(19,107,98,.035), 0 0 0 44px rgba(19,107,98,.025); }

    .cta-card h2 {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      max-width: 620px;
      margin: 0 auto 13px;
      font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      font-size: clamp(38px, 4.3vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: -2px;
      line-height: 1.08;
    }

    .cta-card p {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .cta-card .button { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    .cta-note {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      margin-top: 13px;
      color: #74877d;
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    footer {
      padding: 27px 0 33px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(24, 59, 58, .1);
    }

    .footer-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 20px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .footer-brand { color: var(--ink); }
    .footer-links { display: flex; gap: 23px; }
    .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--teal); }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 30px; padding-top: 66px; }
      .hero-copy { max-width: 650px; }
      .hero-art { width: min(100%, 650px); margin: 0 auto; }
      .board { margin-inline: auto; }
      .floating-note { right: 0; }
      .how-grid { gap: 48px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 700px) {
      .shell { width: min(100% - 36px, 560px); }
      .nav { height: 70px; }
      .nav-links, .nav-login { display: none; }
      .nav-actions { gap: 0; }
      .nav-actions .button { min-height: 41px; padding-inline: 14px; font-size: 12px; }
      .hero { min-height: auto; padding: 57px 0 55px; }
      h1 { font-size: clamp(48px, 13vw, 66px); letter-spacing: -2.8px; }
      .hero-text { font-size: 15px; }
      .hero-art { padding: 17px 0; }
      .blob { width: 340px; height: 340px; }
      .board { transform: none; }
      .board-top { padding: 13px 14px; }
      .board-intro { padding: 15px 14px 12px; }
      .day { min-height: 239px; padding: 10px 5px; }
      .day-name { display: block; text-align: center; }
      .day-name b { margin: 5px auto 0; }
      .task { padding: 7px 5px; font-size: 8px; }
      .task small { font-size: 7px; }
